title: Sections over the point commute with scalar extension
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\neq p$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\Ql$, and $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. For finite extensions $E\subset L$ of $\Ql$ in $\Qlb$ and $K\in D^b_c(s,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], let $K\widehat\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L\in D^b_c(s,\mathcal O_L)$ be the integral scalar extension of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] (completed derived tensor product [def-weil-derived-tensor] with $\mathcal O_L$). Let $\Gamma(s,-)$ be sections over the final object of $s_{\mathrm{proet}}$ on derived categories [lem-weil-point-proetale-sections-exact]. Then there is an isomorphism

$$
 \varphi_{L/E,K}:\Gamma\bigl(s,K\widehat\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L\bigr)\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\Gamma(s,K)\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L
$$

in $D(\mathcal O_L)$, natural in $K$, equal to the identity for $L=E$, and such that for $E\subset L\subset M$ the isomorphism $\varphi_{M/E,K}$ equals the composite of $\varphi_{M/L,K\widehat\otimes\mathcal O_L}$, $\varphi_{L/E,K}\otimes_{\mathcal O_L}\mathcal O_M$, the canonical isomorphism $(N\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L)\otimes_{\mathcal O_L}\mathcal O_M\cong N\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_M$ of complexes, and the composition isomorphism of scalar extension [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition]. Tensoring with $L$ over $\mathcal O_L$, these give natural isomorphisms $\Gamma(s,K\widehat\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L)\otimes_{\mathcal O_L}L\cong(\Gamma(s,K)\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}E)\otimes_EL$ in $D(L)$, with the same compatibilities.
